title: 2007.5-2012 6.7 Cummins XR2 Series Turbocharger 64mm/64mm HE300VG

spec_lines: This XR2 Series HE351VGT Turbocharger comes with an upgraded Billet Blade Technology 64mm compressor wheel. The Billet Blade Technology compressor wheel is designed to increase turbo efficiency to help lower EGT's while adding strength and reliability. Because of the high failure rates with Holset Remanufactured Turbochargers, we are proud to use only 100% BRAND NEW turbos direct from the manufacturer. This ensures more reliability and longevity than any other competitor on the market.
Upgraded with an 7 Blade 64.5mm Billet Blade Technology compressor wheel
Slim nose designed compressor wheel for increased wheel efficiency
